title: Fixed Open Scalloped Wall and Rolled Rim Ring
description: One newly authored complete empty scalloped pastry-ring exterior. One continuous finite metal-looking wall follows a twelve-lobed wavy plan around a genuinely open centre from its lower edge to its upper mouth. A complete outward rounded rolled-rim profile returns into the inner wall around the same entire scalloped outline. The lower edge is blunt and has a real annular thickness, not a sharp zero-width cutting surface. Both ends are fully open with no floor, die, insert, handle or top disk. One closed editable shell, one constant opaque satin PBR material, metres Z up and bounds-centred lower-rim ground datum. All numerical geometry newly authored, not a mooncake mould with its floor removed, not a scaled thimble, cup or extracted rolled collar. Unlike the old thick square wooden blind-cavity mould with raised floral die and long handle, this is a standalone thin through-open ring with a full rolled lip. One original whole model zero scenes. Static bakery art only: no dough, biscuit, cutting or stamping operation, food-contact suitability, hygiene, finger fit, edge sharpness, strength, manufacturing or safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
